name: Common pheasant
desc: Ring-necked Pheasant (Phasianus colchicus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 101 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The common pheasant, ring-necked pheasant, or blue-headed pheasant, is a bird in the pheasant family (Phasianidae). The genus name comes from Latin phasianus 'pheasant'.
